selection: Highest validation phone classification across 30 epochs; validation and actual inference controls reviewed before opening final test.
knownLimitations: Synthetic references only; no human rating validation or listening review.
Held-out AU and IN phone classification is weaker; AU held-out profile also changes TTS provider.
A fast AU validation sample has median syllable similarity 56.235 and one uncertain syllable despite transcript coverage. AU/IN do not have locale-specific G2P dictionaries.
